propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered workflow saturates the Free plan's 20 concurrent job limit during representative bursts, causing runner queuing delays up to 14+ minutes.
The incident initially attributed to tickets-branch pushes is factually incorrect; tickets is an orphan branch with no workflows and produced zero Actions runs.

Current per-run job cost ranges from 17 jobs (no mutation shards) to 24 jobs (all seven mutation shards), with a 13-way fan-out immediately after classification creating 22+ waiting jobs during concurrent dispatches.

Four mutually exclusive first-move remediation options are costed: demand reduction via job bundling and mutation parallelism cap, coalescing superseded patchsets, moving macOS to scheduled branch health, or upgrading organization plan from Free to Team.
